meaning: Review checklist, not an assertion that captured resources have been decoded.

requirements.name: Camera, jitter, depth and motion
requirements.evidence: Constant buffers, G-buffer producers and reconstruction inputs in complete GPU capture

requirements.name: Geometry, instances, TLAS/BLAS and shader tables
requirements.evidence: DXR dispatch and acceleration structure data in PIX capture

requirements.name: Materials, textures, normals, roughness, metalness and opacity
requirements.evidence: Hit shader libraries, geometry/material buffers and descriptors in capture

requirements.name: Lights, emissives, environment and shadow visibility
requirements.evidence: Native lighting and shadow passes, buffers and resources in capture

requirements.name: Native lighting composition and exposure
requirements.evidence: Pass order, shader code, input/output resources and constants in capture

requirements.name: RR inputs and output
requirements.evidence: RR-on and RR-off captures; proprietary implementation may not replay

requirements.name: Proxy-disabled native reference
requirements.evidence: Two separate-launch views with known R1/R2 proxy temporarily disabled; verify baseline-session.json and retained installation hashes

requirements.name: Temporal behavior
requirements.evidence: Each capture is one frame with its incoming history resources; no continuous temporal sequence

requirements.name: Other rooms, streaming, characters and effects
requirements.evidence: Only content present in the entrance frames is covered
